name: Raudkorna
description: Centuries ago, a strange affliction descended upon the forests of east Breithlond. Although the trees do not die outright, the leaves now seem to burn with the color of flame. The entire area seemed newly alive with elemental energy, and every year the blight seemed to creep a few miles outward. Cults of worship of Baldur, a God of Light, arose among the hamlets and vills of the region, but vicious enmity on the part of Erebus (worshiped by the fallen Giants and other adherents of Chaos) led to the death of Baldur, the end of the spread of the Red Blight, and whispers of a dread fate for all Iago. Even so, the Potluck Plague pushed refugees into the region, settling in the flametouched recesses of what is now known as the Raudkorna, or red horn. Although the spread of the blight has ceased, it seems that the raw elemental magic of the area has lost none of its potency, as the newly arrived peoples begin to notice changes in themselves…
